episodes.synopsis: It's 1932 and Firo arrives to check up on Isaac and Miria, to see that they are having some fun with some friends playing dominos. Elsewhere in New York a mechanic named Graham Spector is infuriated that someone has recently injured Ladd Russo and begins to reminisce of the time they first met. In 1931, Elmer C. Albatross visits fellow immortal Huey Laforet, in prison and Huey ask him for a favor involving his daughter Chane. Rachel meets Czeslaw, who decides to tell her about the events that took place on the Flying Pussyfoot.

Nel mentre, si inasprisce la guerra oscura tra i clan della malavita americana. Gli alchimisti impareranno che l'immortalità ha un prezzo salatissimo da pagare.
